name: Rocky Memphis: The Legend of Atlantis
summary: Rocky Memphis: The Legend of Atlantis sends you deep into ancient temple ruins on a quest to uncover the secret of the lost city. Among sand and stone, you'll search for clues, collect items, solve puzzles, and activate hidden mechanisms. But the temple is deadly – more deadly than its silence suggests: scorpions, bats, and cruel traps await at every turn. Only with wit, courage, and the spirit of adventure can you solve the mystery of Atlantis.
